'''Sean Reyes''' (born '''Sean Elias-Reyes'''; also credited as '''Sean Kenin''') is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency in New York and SBV Talent Agency in Los Angeles.

==Biography==
Reyes was born sometime on October 7 and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'' and has since voiced several characters in the {{pkmn|animated series}}. In his personal life, Reyes is married to fellow Pokémon voice actor [[Rosie Reyes]] and co-owns the New York City dubbing studio Hyperbolic Audio with another fellow Pokémon voice actor, [[Julián Rebolledo]].
